name: Zadok
overview: Zadok is a male descendant of the tribe of Judah, identified specifically as the son of Azor within the lineage of the Messiah. His mention is brief and primarily genealogical, emphasizing his place in the ancestral line leading to Christ as recorded in Matthew 1:14. There are no additional notes or details about his life or character beyond this lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name Zadok means 'righteous one,' reflecting a proper name with a meaningful Hebrew root. This name is not indicated as being given by God but is recorded in Matthew 1:14. The meaning highlights a character trait valued in biblical tradition but no further titles are associated with him.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Zadok as the father of Achim and, by inference, the son of Azor, establishing his place within the Messianic genealogy. These relationships show his direct link in the ancestral line leading to Jesus Christ. No other family relationships are documented beyond these connections.
scriptureSignificance: Zadok's significance lies chiefly in his role as a link in the genealogical chain that establishes Jesus Christ's human ancestry through the tribe of Judah. His mention in Matthew 1:14 situates him within the providential unfolding of God's redemptive plan, underscoring the fulfillment of Messianic prophecy through a documented lineage. Although not prominent in narrative events, his inclusion affirms the historical reality of Christ's descent.
